method: MCP browser (pwmcp-zonacnc) — navigate+resize+snapshot+evaluate at 1280/768/375px for Vendor Directory page
anti_duplicate_note: Previous tests today covered: category-tornos (1315), CMS (1300), login (1215), registro (1145), contact (1130), producto (1100), search (0945), pricing (0900). THIS test: Exclusively focuses on Vendor Directory page (`/es/vendedores/`) — vendor card layout, filter form responsiveness, footer accordion behavior at 3 breakpoints
scenario: Vendor Directory page (/es/vendedores/) responsive layout at 1280/768/375px — verifying vendor card structure, filter form stacking, header/nav responsive behavior, footer accordion at mobile, and tap target compliance

layout.top_bar: Contacte con nosotros + Vendedores (icon+text) + Tarifas (icon+text) + language selector + Iniciar sesión
layout.main_nav: Logo + Categorías (text+dropdown) + search bar + Vender máquina (icon+text)
layout.subtitle: Encuentra vendedores profesionales de maquinaria industrial en toda España
layout.filter_area: Provincia select + Buscar empresa input + Buscar button
layout.vendor_card_width: full page width, single column stack
layout.footer: 5 columns fully expanded + Categorías destacadas + Marcas líderes
layout.extra_elements: Test banner, Back-to-top, Chat, Cookie consent

layout.top_bar: Contacte con nosotros + Vendedores (icon ONLY) + Tarifas (icon ONLY) + language selector + Iniciar sesión
layout.main_nav: Logo + Categorías (icon ONLY) + search bar + Vender máquina (icon ONLY)
layout.content: Same as desktop — all vendors visible, filters functional

responsive_behaviors.nav_text_hidden: PASS — Vendedores, Tarifas, Categorías text labels hidden, icons remain

layout.nav: Logo + Categorías (icon) + language selector + 'Mostrar barra de búsqueda' button + login icon + Vender máquina icon
layout.filter_area: Provincia select + Buscar empresa input + 'Buscar' button stacked vertically
layout.extra_elements: Test banner ✓, Back-to-top ✓, Chat ✓, Cookie dialog ✓

responsive_behaviors.no_hamburger_menu: Categorías icon link serves as nav trigger (no off-canvas menu panel found)

header_nav_responsive.desktop_1280: Full text labels on all nav elements
header_nav_responsive.tablet_768: Nav text labels hidden (icons only) — correct responsive behavior
header_nav_responsive.mobile_375: Minimal nav: logo, categorías icon, language, search toggle, login, vender icon
header_nav_responsive.verdict: PASS — nav appropriately collapses at each breakpoint

vendor_cards_responsive.desktop_1280: Full-width single column cards with 76x76px images where available
vendor_cards_responsive.mobile_375: 321px wide (85% viewport) — good use of space, no text overflow
vendor_cards_responsive.fallback_icons: 4/7 vendors show 'business' icon instead of logo (test data issue, not responsive)
vendor_cards_responsive.verdict: PASS — cards adapt well across all breakpoints

filter_form_responsive.desktop_1280: Row layout: select + input + button inline
filter_form_responsive.mobile_375: Stacked vertically: select, input, button each full width
filter_form_responsive.verdict: PASS_WITH_NOTES — functional at all breakpoints, search button 1px short on height

footer_responsive.desktop_1280: 5 columns fully expanded with all links visible
footer_responsive.mobile_375: 5 sections collapsed to accordion with toggle buttons

footer_accordion_toggles.recommendation: Increase accordion toggle buttons from 24x26px to ≥44x44px for WCAG touch compliance
footer_accordion_toggles.note: This is a global footer issue — affects ALL pages, not just vendor directory

console_errors.pattern: Provider's accounts list is empty / FedCM get() rejects with NetworkError

horizontal_overflow.verdict: PASS — NO horizontal overflow at any tested breakpoint

notes: Vendor directory page responsive at all 3 breakpoints
Header nav correctly collapses text labels at tablet (icons-only)
Vendor cards stack vertically at mobile with adequate 85% viewport width
Filter form switches from inline row to vertical stack at mobile
Zero horizontal overflow at all breakpoints
MEDIUM: Footer accordion toggle buttons at 24x26px — well below 44x44px WCAG minimum (5 buttons affected)
LOW: Search button height 43px (1px below 44px WCAG minimum)
Non-critical Google FedCM console errors persist across all site pages
summary.unique_scenario: Vendor Directory page responsive test — first focused analysis on /es/vendedores/ with vendor card layout, filter form responsiveness, and footer accordion behavior at mobile
